tweets.body: While most theories of nervous system function emphasize development, secretory signaling, motor coordination, and input-output responses, we here highlight intrinsic periodic activity as a key element of early nerve nets, and discuss the many ways it can arise.

tweets.body:
CycleGAN skips the manifold extraction step, operating directly on neural activity. So you can use it with decoders that take high-dimensional input!

It can also be used to "synthesize" predicted neural activity, a function we're still wondering how to use 🤔
